in_marathi.name: Himagir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Himagir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words, 'Hima' meaning snow and 'giri' meaning mountain, this name is often used to depict someone with a strong and stable character.
